metadata.timezone_policy: IANA coordinate time zones, including daylight saving and Eucla; road driving 09:00–17:00 local; approved overnight ferry cabin exception.
metadata.ordering: Tasmania then mainland, nearest-neighbour with anchored open-tour 2-opt using great-circle distances; Google road routing for every leg. Kalgoorlie moved before Esperance after a Google road-distance comparison. Heuristic, not proven optimal.
metadata.sampling: Full high-quality polylines and per-step durations; no telemetry sampling applied.
assumptions: 30-minute site visits; store opening hours are not enforced.
Static Google traffic-unaware travel durations; no live congestion.
Accommodation places are real; room availability is not checked.
Tasmania ferry geometry and duration are from Google, with an illustrative 20:00 departure and overnight cabin; no dated sailing or cabin availability is verified.

calendar.policy: 46 elapsed days of history before local midnight; 30 elapsed days of future data. Daily road trips start at 09:00 local, with original route and visit durations. Overnight waits use the installation calendar and IANA daylight-saving rules.
